scope: Direct fixed compiled-global constant with one source-authenticated singleton literal ARRAY unpack: positional key 0 or named key name, with the exact HALT string. No owner, selected call, fallback, variable pack or Traversable. Partial dynamic-source behavior.
engine_route: Zend/zend_compile.c::zend_compile_args emits SEND_UNPACK; Zend/zend_vm_def.h::ZEND_SEND_UNPACK binds integer or named keys before the API. ext/standard/basic_functions.c::PHP_FUNCTION(constant) calls zend_get_constant_ex; Zend/zend_constants.c::zend_get_halt_offset_constant uses the executed filename.
mechanism: At authentic CONFIG_INVOKE, bind one raw NExprArray singleton with exact literal HALT value and omitted or literal name key. Require fixed global constant, empty selection/owner, one pack matching the argument origin, valid source line, captured entry/key and one normalized SENT, plus agreement with an allocated permanent compiled array. Only constant HALT_OFFSET and HALT_ABSENT Error arms add this admission; selected and direct-value paths retain their separate gates.

validation.native_first: Eight frozen author originals passed pinned CLI0 with exact stdout and empty stderr. In the genuine unchanged checked model, five packed HALT sources were Unsupported with zero agreement credit; wrong-key and duplicate-binding errors already matched before HALT, while variable pack stayed Unsupported.
validation.changed_sources: Five packed HALT originals now agree exactly: same-file positional and named offset, two absent Error traces, child offset with caller absence, and eval absence with main offset. Wrong-key and duplicate-binding diagnostics remain exact. The variable-pack control remains Unsupported and has zero agreement credit.
validation.reached_state: Five genuine checked strict-SL fixtures pass 123+79+79+152+14=447 checks. They bind positional and named singleton pack receipts to real CONFIG_INVOKE sites, compiled literal pool roots, filename-local journal, budget0/resume and actual result/Error steps; reject forged site/line/key/value/owner metadata and HALT_UNKNOWN; and reach a variable-pack Unsupported front. The 14 control checks have zero native agreement credit.
validation.independent: A separately frozen included child function with an absent HALT lookup, later called from a HALT main, matches native exactly, distinguishing the compiled child call-site filename from the active caller filename.
validation.failed_attempts: Two changed-model runs and one module-load gate stopped before semantics on the new SpecTec singleton SEQUENCE pattern; their raw reports retain zero credit. The corrected 423-module strict load gate passed before the affected source and state runs.

environment.resources: Author native/baseline, changed-source and reached-state runs and the independent reviewer source run used serial numbered CPU leases; every actor was fully reaped and the lease released.

raw_artifacts.recovery: Run halt_pack_sources.py --phase native then --phase model on the same fresh output root with its generated version-2 child snapshot. Run halt_pack_protocol.py --sources SOURCE_ROOT --output FRESH for five reached fronts. Keep unchanged Unsupported and pre-semantics failures outside agreement totals.

review: Independent semantic/test/docs review accepted behavior commit fd2602c66 and the 447-check author state packet. The separately frozen child-function original passed exact native/model, while the variable-pack front and pre-semantic failures retain zero agreement credit. Inventory and scoped documentation were reviewed.
remaining: Variable/multiple/Traversable packs, owning or selected packed calls, other named keys, repeated call-site cache history, ambiguous HALT registration and wider dynamic-source/provider behavior remain partial.
